title: SDK Rapid Onboard Kit: structured-output & streaming samples + release notes orchestration
creator: Sofia Patel
description:
Goal: Produce an "onboard kit" bundle to accelerate customer adoption of the new SDK surfaces (function calling, structured output schemas, streaming). The kit includes: a curated sample catalog (Node/Python/Go), a set of short walkthroughs for common integration patterns, a release-notes skeleton tailored for platform and SDK docs, a migration checklist, and a telemetry/alert wiring guide for early detection of regressions.

Scope:
- Docs: Quickstarts, API diff page, migration guide, structured-output contract examples, streaming consumer patterns.
- Samples: 9 end-to-end samples (3 languages x 3 patterns: sync function-calls, structured-output + validation, streaming incremental UI). Samples should be runnable with minimal setup and include tests that validate responses against schema.
- Release notes: stakeholder-ready notes for public and internal channels, with callouts for breaking vs non-breaking changes, SDK compatibility table, and recommended upgrade timeline.
- Cross-team GTM: engineering staging checklist, developer relations enablement plan, support triage runbook, and partner pilot contact list.

Success metrics: onboarding time for a new integration <= 90 minutes with samples; 80% of pilot partners complete basic function-calling flow within 1 week; no P0 regressions in first 2 weeks post-launch.

Constraints and risks: runtime API surface changes not finalized (ENG-11012). Localization of samples is deprioritized for first wave. Streaming SDKs require small API ergonomics adjustments (ENG-11305). Design assets for UX snippets are pending DES-207.

Deliverables:
- samples/catalog-v1 (zipped sample repo + README)
- docs/quickstart-structured-output.md
- docs/streaming-ui-patterns.md
- release-notes/sdk-2026.03.md (internal + public variants)
- telemetry/wiring-playbook.md

Owner: Marcus Lee (PM). Engineering lead: Priya Raman. Design lead: Mateo Alvarez. DevRel lead: Hannah Kim.
